title: F19 · log_kya_kahenge · What Will People Say
lines: She wants to take a job in another city. That is all.
One uncle says it is not safe. One aunt says it is not proper.
A neighbour has not said anything yet, but she will.
Her mother has started to waver.
Dadi, from her chair, started laughing.
People said Parvati's groom was a beggar with ghosts for friends.
"People said Parvati's groom was a beggar with ghosts for friends.
She married him anyway. Ask them how that turned out.
She married him anyway. Ask them how that turned out."
Her mother folded the offer letter,
and put it in her own purse, to keep it safe.
People will always say something. Go as you are. That is sadhana.
